title: Production-Ready Multilingual Voice AI Agent
requirements: Provider-neutral domain architecture with Gemini Live and OpenAI Realtime adapters.
At least one external STT and one external TTS adapter or a demonstrated chained pipeline.
Arabic, English, and code-switching evaluation fixtures.
Streaming, turn detection, barge-in, playback cancellation, reconnect, and session continuity.
At least three tools; one must have a side effect with authorization, confirmation, timeout, cancellation, and idempotency.
Grounded RAG with provenance/source handling and latency/failure behavior.
Session/context state plus explicitly scoped persistent memory.
At least one durable workflow that can outlive the immediate voice turn and survive reconnect.
At least two fault scenarios among realtime provider, STT/TTS, tool, RAG, rate limit, remote agent, or network failure.
Observability covering first-audio latency, endpointing, interruption, tools/RAG, provider errors, fallback, workflow IDs, and traces.
Voice evaluation suite covering clean English/Arabic, code-switching, noise, pauses, interruption, rapid follow-up, tool/RAG, ambiguous input, and provider failure.
Security: no permanent provider secret in client; authenticated sessions; scoped tool/agent authorization; audio/transcript retention policy; redacted sensitive logs.
Production release design with staging gate, session-sticky canary or Blue/Green, connection draining, rollback, and registry version/health tracking.
